method: Full funded cash-flow deltas on frozen model; capex, depreciation, working capital, operating taxes, finite credits and retained cash recomputed under predeclared policy. All2000+ nominal values and macro assumptions otherwise unchanged.

limitations: New quote snapshots are intraday, not closing prices; no real transaction was entered.
Earlier macro calibration is retained as a declared control, not refreshed intraday.
Permanent relative unit loss is a scenario, not established by one2027 forecast.
Minority cash waterfall remains an aggregate reserve; no unverified legal obligation stacked onto this diagnostic.
2026 valuations areDec31planning values, not exact Nov4/5 fairvalues.
